consent.title: What is QUIVER & Why We Exist
consent.subtitle: Understanding our partnership model
consent.description: Quiver is a rural enterprise growth and investment partnership platform. We work with rural and semi-rural entrepreneurs who already run businesses but face challenges in scaling due to lack of systems, market access, strategic guidance, and patient capital.
consent.challenge: Quiver exists because capital alone does not build strong businesses — and systems without capital cannot grow. We partner long-term with entrepreneurs to strengthen business fundamentals, enable market access, and explore growth capital when enterprises are ready.
reasons: Loans or grants alone don't build strong businesses
Capital without systems becomes a risk
And systems without capital remain incomplete
consent.whatWeDo: Quiver works in long-term partnership with entrepreneurs. We:
services: Strengthen sales, costs, profits and operations
Connect you to markets, networks and experts
And when the business is ready, explore growth capital (investment / revenue-share)
consent.notProgram: Quiver is not a grant or subsidy program.
consent.partner: Entrepreneurs are partners in a shared growth journey. Our goal is to build dignified, sustainable, and investment-ready rural enterprises.
consent.consent1: I am interested in exploring a structured business-growth journey with Quiver
consent.consent2: I understand that Quiver is not a grant or subsidy program

equity.subtitle: Understanding investment partnership

explainer.title: Understanding Equity Investment
explainer.meaning: Equity means when a partner invests money to grow your business and, in return, takes a limited share in the business's profits and decisions. There is no compulsory monthly repayment.
explainer.notJustMoney: Working with Quiver is not just about receiving money. It is about entering a long-term partnership.
explainer.loanVsEquity: In many cases, loans are not enough for business growth.

loanFeatures.struggle: Repayment is required even if the business struggles

equityFeatures.partner: Quiver becomes a growth partner in your business
equityFeatures.invest: Quiver invests money, time, and guidance to help the business grow
equityFeatures.growBenefit: If the business grows well, both benefit
equityFeatures.riskShared: If the business faces challenges, the risk is shared

explainer.noMonthlyPressure: There is no fixed monthly repayment pressure
explainer.sameGoal: Both Quiver and the entrepreneur work toward the same goal: business growth
